key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:05B6
name: clear_block_and_init_flags
description: Zeroes a 32-word global block, copies one global value into two other globals and resets that source to zero, then sets another global to one and clears the guard flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:05C4
name: dispatch_audio_channel_match
description: Calls a handler routine when a global value equals one of four stored values, then resets that global to zero. Audio channel location registers are among the hardware registers it touches.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:064E
name: clear_four_blocks_under_flag
description: Sets the guard flag, then four times calls a routine and zeroes a 32-word global block, and finally clears the guard flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:06E6
name: set_flag_and_store_value
description: Sets one global flag to 1, stores the incoming D0 register value into a second global, and writes 64 to a third global.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:06FE
name: set_state_two_store_value
description: Sets one global to 2, stores the incoming D0 register value into a second global, and clears a third global to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0716
name: validate_then_fill_slot
description: Returns early for a zero input, an input above 64, or a value already held by an entry. Otherwise it picks a slot from stored values, fills that slot's fields from the inputs, runs a follow-up dispatch on a global code and clears the guard flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:079A
name: choose_slot_and_fill
description: Chooses slot one, two or three when a stored flag is zero, otherwise the slot holding the lowest of four stored values, returning early if the input is below that value. It then fills the slot's fields, calls a routine around a flagged step and dispatches a follow-up on a global code.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:07AC
name: choose_slot_and_fill
description: Chooses slot one, two or three when a stored flag is zero, otherwise the slot holding the lowest of four stored values, returning early if the input is below that value. It then fills the slot's fields, calls a routine around a flagged step and dispatches a follow-up on a global code.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:07D2
name: choose_slot_skip_first_check
description: Chooses a slot from stored flags and values, taking slot two when its flag is zero and slot three when the next flag is zero, and otherwise the lowest-valued slot. It then fills the slot's fields and runs the same flagged follow-up dispatch as its siblings.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:07F2
name: choose_slot_prefer_third
description: Takes slot three when its stored flag is zero, otherwise picks the lowest-valued of four stored slots and returns early if the input is below it. It then fills the chosen slot's fields and runs the flagged follow-up dispatch on a global code.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0812
name: choose_lowest_value_slot
description: Picks the slot holding the lowest of four stored values, defaulting to slot four, and returns early if the input is below that value. It then fills the slot's fields and runs the flagged follow-up dispatch.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0832
name: fill_slot_if_threshold_met
description: Selects the slot with the lowest of four stored values and fills its fields only when the input is at or above that value. The fill is followed by the same flagged dispatch on a global code.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:089A
name: fill_record_and_finish
description: Fills a four-field record addressed by an address register with the input values, sets a flag around a routine call, then runs the common follow-up dispatch on a global code and clears the guard flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:08DE
name: store_value_dispatch_flags
description: Stores a global code into a record field, then sets one of several global flags according to whether the code is 4, 3, 2 or another value, and clears the guard flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0906
name: dispatch_flags_by_code
description: Based on an input word equal to 3, 2 or another value, clears one global flag and sets another, then clears the guard flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0920
name: set_flag_by_code_two
description: If the input word is 2, clears one global and sets another; otherwise clears a different global and sets a third. The guard flag is cleared on exit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:093A
name: reset_flags_and_clear_guard
description: Clears one global flag, sets another global to one, and clears the guard flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0954
name: run_two_steps_clear_guard
description: Calls two routines in sequence and then clears the guard flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0964
name: record_mode_clear_and_fill
description: Sets the record's first field to one, clears one flag chosen by the record's mode value (4, 3 or 2, otherwise a default), then copies the input registers into the record's fields and zeroes its last field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:097E
name: clear_mode_flag_fill_record
description: Clears one flag chosen by a mode value (3, 2 or another value), then copies the input registers into the record's fields and zeroes its last field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0990
name: clear_binary_flag_fill_record
description: Clears one of two global flags depending on whether a mode value equals two, then sets the record's first word to one, copies the input registers into its following fields and zeroes its last word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:09A4
name: clear_flag_and_fill_record
description: Clears one global flag, then sets the record's first word to one, copies the input registers into its following fields and zeroes its last word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:09AA
name: store_regs_to_record
description: Sets the record's first word to one, copies four input data registers and an address-register value into its following fields, and zeroes its last word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:09C8
name: write_channel_regs_if_free
description: Zeroes the record's last word, then selects one of four channel groups by the record's mode value. If that group's flag is clear it writes two record fields to that channel's hardware register block, otherwise it clears the record's first and fourth fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:09CE
name: set_audio_channel_data
description: Selects one of four channel groups by the record's mode value and, when that group's flag is clear, writes two record fields to its hardware register block. If the flag is set it clears the record's first and fourth fields instead. The audio channel registers are listed among the hardware registers it touches.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0ABE
name: reset_state_from_selector
description: Saves a global value, zeroes a 136-word global block, and when a selector global is non-zero loads four pointer globals from a table indexed by it and points eight globals at the block. It then writes constants one to eight into fixed globals, clears control globals, restores the saved value, and calls a routine when the selector equals ten.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0AC2
name: reset_state_from_selector
description: Entry point with the same body as its neighbours: saves a global value, zeroes a 136-word global block, and when a selector global is non-zero loads four pointer globals from a table indexed by it and points eight globals at the block. It then writes constants one to eight into fixed globals, clears control globals, restores the saved value, and calls a routine when the selector equals ten.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0C2C
name: tick_four_channel_timers
description: Returns while the guard flag is set. Otherwise it advances a step counter, then for four groups increments a counter and, once it passes 50, decrements a level and calls a routine, clearing the group when the level drops below two. It finishes with four selector-based checks that call routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0E1C
name: clear_flag_by_code_dispatch
description: Clears one of four global flags according to an input code (4, 3, 2 or 1) and calls a routine after the clear. Any other code does nothing.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0F10
name: set_flag_and_call_routine
description: Sets one global flag to one and calls a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0F34
name: reset_groups_and_load_entry
description: Calls a routine, then clears the paired globals of each group whose flag is one, stores a table entry indexed by a global value into a fixed slot, and clears two control globals.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0FB0
name: clear_flag_and_call_routine
description: Sets one global flag to zero and calls a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:0FD4
name: set_flag_and_call_routine
description: Sets one global flag to one and calls a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:106C
name: set_flag_and_call_routine
description: Sets one global flag to one and calls a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1090
name: load_table_entry_clear_counter
description: Calls a routine, copies a table entry selected by a global index into a fixed slot, then clears that index and a second counter global.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:10BC
name: clear_flag_and_call_routine
description: Sets one global flag to zero and calls a routine.

name: set_flag_and_call_routine
description: Sets one global flag to one and calls a routine.

name: set_flag_and_call_routine
description: Sets one global flag to one and calls a routine.

name: load_table_entry_clear_counter
description: Calls a routine, copies a table entry selected by a global index into a fixed slot, then clears that index and a second counter global.

name: load_table_entry_clear_counter
description: Calls a routine, copies a table entry selected by a global index into a fixed slot, then clears that index and a second counter global.

name: clear_flag_and_call_routine
description: Sets one global flag to zero and calls a routine.

name: set_flag_and_call_routine
description: Sets one global flag to one and calls a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:131E
name: advance_command_stream_step
description: When the step counter is zero, reads the next command word from a stream, stores its value and duration in a record, and reloads the counter, ending the step on a zero command. Otherwise it decrements the counter. It then applies timed level adjustments to a stored level and writes the result to an output word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:149E
name: start_command_stream
description: Reads the first command word from a stream pointer, stores its value and duration in a record, and resets the stream pointer. It writes the next stream value to an output word, reduced by a parameter when that parameter is non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:14EE
name: reset_stream_to_global_buffer
description: Stores a duration from an input record, decrements a counter, and points the stream at a shared global buffer. It writes the next value to an output word, reduced by a parameter when that parameter is non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1574
name: fetch_next_stream_entry
description: Reads the next entry from a list, counting down a repeat count or taking the next pointer, and returns on a zero command word. Otherwise it stores the entry's value and duration in a record and writes the next output word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1586
name: read_next_stream_entry
description: Decrements a count and reads the next entry from a list, returning on a zero command word. Otherwise it stores the entry's value and duration in a record and writes the next output word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1594
name: clear_port_bit_start_stream
description: Clears bit one of a port status global, then reads the first command word from a stream pointer, stores its value and duration, and writes the next output word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:15A0
name: set_port_bit_start_stream
description: Sets bit one of a port status global, then reads the first command word from a stream pointer, stores its value and duration, and writes the next output word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:15AC
name: load_stream_pointer_and_fetch
description: Loads a stream descriptor from a pointer into a record, then reads the command at the selected index and, if non-zero, stores its value and duration and writes the next output word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:15DC
name: advance_stream_pointer_fetch
description: Advances a stream pointer through a list, wrapping to a stored base when it reaches a zero entry. It then reads the entry's command word and, if non-zero, stores its value and duration in a record and writes the next output word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:15F6
name: store_base_and_read_entry
description: Stores a long value from an input pointer into a record field and points the record's stream at the following entry. It then reads that entry's command word and, if non-zero, stores its value and duration and writes the next output word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1604
name: store_pair_and_read_entry
description: Stores two long values from an input block into record fields, then reads the entry at the given offset. A zero command word returns; otherwise the value and duration are stored and the next output word is written.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1610
name: store_triple_and_read_entry
description: Sets a record flag to one, stores three long values from an input block into record fields, then reads the entry at the given offset. A zero command word returns; otherwise the value and duration are stored and the next output word is written.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1626
name: clear_field_and_read_entry
description: Clears a record field, then reads the next stream entry. A zero command word returns; otherwise the value and duration are stored and the next output word is written.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:162E
name: clear_flag_and_read_entry
description: Clears a record flag, then reads the next stream entry. A zero command word returns; otherwise the value and duration are stored and the next output word is written.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1636
name: map_code_to_state
description: For codes 6, 5, 7 and 8 it writes fixed values to a shared global location and clears the matching flag. Any other code returns without change.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1658
name: pulse_state_one_clear_flag
description: Writes the value 1, then one, then zero to a shared global location, so it ends at zero. It also clears a separate flag, and the audio hardware registers listed in the facts are among those it touches.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:167C
name: pulse_state_two_clear_flag
description: Writes the value 2, then one, then zero to a shared global location, so it ends at zero. It also clears a separate flag, and the audio hardware registers listed in the facts are among those it touches.

name: pulse_state_four_clear_flag
description: Writes the value 4, then one, then zero to a shared global location, so it ends at zero. It also clears a separate flag, and the audio hardware registers listed in the facts are among those it touches.

name: pulse_state_eight_clear_flag
description: Writes the value 8, then one, then zero to a shared global location, so it ends at zero. It also clears a separate flag, and the audio hardware registers listed in the facts are among those it touches.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:16E8
name: pulse_state_one
description: Writes the value 1, then one, then zero to a shared global location, so it ends at zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1702
name: pulse_state_two
description: Writes the value 2, then one, then zero to a shared global location, so it ends at zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:171C
name: pulse_state_four
description: Writes the value 4, then one, then zero to a shared global location, so it ends at zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1736
name: pulse_state_eight
description: Writes the value 8, then one, then zero to a shared global location, so it ends at zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1750
name: set_field_and_read_entry
description: Sets a record field to one, then reads the next stream entry. A zero command word returns; otherwise the value and duration are stored and the next output word is written.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:1762
name: read_next_pointer_entry
description: Reads the entry at the record's current pointer and advances the pointer by one. If its command word is non-zero it stores the value and duration and writes the next output word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:26314
name: clear_byte_call_set_flag
description: Clears a byte in a record addressed through a base register, calls a routine, then sets a global flag to one and returns the routine's result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:2632E
name: call_routine_then_set_flag
description: Calls a routine, sets a global flag to one, and returns the register values unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:26346
name: find_next_set_table_entry
description: Scans an eight-entry byte table for the next non-zero entry, starting from a stored index and wrapping around. It stores the found index in a record field and index plus one in a global, then calls a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:263CE
name: set_flag_from_status_zero
description: Sets a flag byte to all ones when a status byte is zero, and to zero otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:263D2
name: set_flag_from_zero_condition
description: Stores a flag byte that is all ones when the zero condition from the preceding comparison is set, and zero otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:263D8
name: reset_index_and_set_nine
description: Sets a stored index to minus one, clears a flag byte and a global, writes nine to another global, and calls a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:26402
name: forward_value_unless_twenty
description: When an enable flag byte is set, returns without action if the input is twenty and a second flag is clear. Otherwise it clears a flag, stores the input into a global and calls a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:26432
name: store_value_and_call_routine
description: Stores the input value into a global and calls a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:26448
name: store_value_if_count_nonzero
description: When an enable flag byte is set, caps a count at 63 and, if it is non-zero, clears a flag, stores the input value into a global and calls a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:26476
name: call_routine_if_index_negative
description: Calls a routine when an enable flag byte is set and a stored index is negative, and returns otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:2649E
name: dispatch_if_small_value_ready
description: When an enable flag byte is set, the input value is below fifteen and a stored word is non-zero, it clears a flag, stores the input into a global and calls a routine. Otherwise it returns without effect.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:264E6
name: set_flag_byte_all_ones
description: Sets a flag byte to 255 and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:3:264EE
name: reset_or_find_table_entry
description: If an enable flag byte is clear, sets a stored index to minus one, clears a flag and a global, writes nine to the global and calls a routine. Otherwise it resets the index, clears a status bit and calls routines if it was set, then scans an eight-entry byte table for the next non-zero entry, storing the index and index plus one before calling a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:7:4DFE
name: return_input_byte
description: Returns its byte input unchanged, with no side effects.

name: return_input_byte
description: Returns its byte input unchanged, with no side effects.

name: return_input_byte

name: return_input_byte

name: return_input_byte

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:3BAC
name: call_five_handler_pointers
description: Calls five function pointers taken from fixed offsets of an address register, with one routine call between the second and third.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:3C40
name: iterate_and_call_table_entries
description: Calls two function pointers, then loops over a count stored in a record. For each entry it calls a function pointer with parameters that step by fixed amounts and wrap, and advances a table pointer by 28 bytes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:534A
name: handle_event_code_three
description: When the input code is three, clears a flag bit and calls function pointers, then runs a routine repeatedly for each count returned by a function pointer, capping one such count at 25 and skipping the optional group when a flag bit is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5848
name: stub_return_immediately
description: Empty stub that only returns, with no calls or memory writes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:584A
name: handle_event_code_three
description: When the input code is three, clears a flag bit and calls function pointers, then runs a routine repeatedly for each count returned by a function pointer, capping one such count at 25 and skipping the optional group when a flag bit is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5906
name: store_scaled_result_pair
description: Sets two byte fields in a record to fixed values, then calls a function pointer and stores its result, with a derived companion value, into two long fields. It finishes by calling one of two function pointers depending on whether both stored values are zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:595C
name: tail_call_handler_pointer
description: Calls a function pointer stored at a fixed offset and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5962
name: copy_block_accumulate_result
description: Copies an eight-word block from one record into another when a flag bit is set, or otherwise sets two byte fields. It then calls a function pointer, adds its wide result to long fields of a record, sets two more bytes, and finishes through a function pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:599E
name: accumulate_and_dispatch_result
description: Sets two record bytes, calls a function pointer for a value, adds a wide result to long fields, and stores a value derived from it in two fields. It then finishes through one of two function pointers depending on a flag bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5A28
name: tail_call_handler_pointer
description: Calls a function pointer stored at a fixed offset and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5A2E
name: stub_return_immediately
description: Empty stub that only returns, with no calls or memory writes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5A30
name: dispatch_countdown_by_value
description: Returns its count minus one unless the count is zero or one. Zero and one take separate paths that set record bytes, call routines, and add 100000 and 200000 to a long field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5A46
name: set_fields_and_call_pair
description: Calls a routine, then if a flag is clear writes an input byte into one record field, calls a routine, writes twenty into another field and calls a routine again.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5A6E
name: set_fields_add_offsets_call
description: Writes an input byte and twenty into record fields between routine calls. When a further flag is clear it adds 100000 and then 200000 to a long field across more calls.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5ACE
name: fetch_table_word_store
description: Calls a function pointer for a value, uses the masked value to look up a word in a global table and stores it in a record field. It then stores the constant 251 in another field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5B14
name: conditional_set_fields_after_call
description: If the zero condition is clear, calls a routine and, unless a returned flag is set, writes 255 and 44 into record fields and copies a byte from a second record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5B58
name: emit_level_bytes_for_command
description: Stores an input command byte in a record and, for codes ten and twelve, adjusts stored counters. It then computes a level from a lookup table and a count, emits a run of bytes while the count remains non-zero, and stores the remaining count and flags in the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5B5C
name: emit_level_bytes_for_command
description: After an initial function-pointer call, stores an input command byte in a record and, for codes ten and twelve, adjusts stored counters. It then computes a level from a lookup table and a count, emits a run of bytes while the count remains non-zero, and stores the remaining count and flags in the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5C26
name: emit_level_bytes_from_registers
description: Stores the high byte of an input word as a table index, computes a level from a lookup table and a count, emits a run of bytes while the count remains non-zero, then stores the remaining count and flags in the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5CAA
name: finish_level_bytes_emit
description: Finishes the level computation: when the input exceeds a threshold it sets a flag bit, emits a run of bytes for the remaining count, and stores the remaining count and flags in the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5D9A
name: lookup_table_entry
description: Computes a search value from a function-pointer result, a record byte and a count, then scans a global table of words for the first entry at or above it and returns the byte at that position.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5DC6
name: call_four_subroutines
description: Calls a routine four times in sequence and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5DDA
name: check_threshold_return_negative
description: Calls a function pointer and stores its result in a record field. If the returned byte exceeds three, it calls further function pointers and returns minus one when the next value is non-negative; otherwise it returns the earlier value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5E34
name: check_flag_and_call
description: If a record's short field is non-zero, calls two function pointers and returns minus one; otherwise returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5E5A
name: scan_bit_flag_loop
description: If a global flag is set, scans a memory region for a byte with bit four set, decrementing a counter that starts from a function-pointer result. Returns minus one when a bit is found and zero otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5E7C
name: store_result_and_call
description: Calls a function pointer, stores its result in a record long field, then calls another function pointer and returns its registers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:9:5E9E
name: clear_structure_fields
description: Calls two function pointers, then clears a long and a word field in a record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:11:382E
name: clear_long_return_byte
description: Clears a long field in a fixed record and returns its byte input unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:11:3862
name: clear_long_field
description: Clears a long field in a fixed record and returns.
